stories.title: Israeli attacks increase Gaza death toll
stories.summary: The Palestinian health ministry said new Israeli attacks killed nine Palestinians and injured 18 others in the past 48 hours. The ministry said one body was recovered from the rubble of previous Israeli attacks. The new attacks put the death toll from Israel's war on Gaza at 73,449 Palestinians, and 174,472 injured since 7 October 2023.

stories.title: They laid down arms. Now ex-guerrillas in Colombia fear fate under new hardline president
stories.summary: ‘Total peace’ plan of previous government led only 99 of Colombia’s 30,000 armed combatants to disarm, but new president Abelardo De la Espriella opposes peace agreements In mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia where they lined up and, one by one, handed their weapons to government officials: rifles, pistols, machine guns and grenade launchers. They also stripped off their heavy tactical vests, field packs and camouflage uniforms, which were each piled into a bonfire to mark the beginning of a new life away from an armed conflict that has claimed nearly half a million lives in the last six decades. stories.headline: They laid down arms. Now ex-guerrillas in Colombia fear fate under new hardline president

opening: ‘Total peace’ plan of previous government led only 99 of Colombia’s 30,000 armed combatants to disarm, but new president Abelardo De la Espriella opposes peace agreements.

In mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia where they lined up and, one by one, handed their weapons to government officials: rifles, pistols, machine guns and grenade launchers.
